177. Other than offences listed in Part V of this Act, the
Commission  may  having  regard  to  the  circumstances  in
which the offence under this Act was committed, compound
such offence for a sum of money not exceeding one half of
the maximum fine imposable for such offence and all such
sums  of  money  received  by  the  Commission  in  the
compounding  of  an  offence  under  this  section  shall  be
credited to the Compensation Fund of the Commission.
